# cord_mini

Three receipts from [CORD v2](https://huggingface.co/datasets/naver-clova-ix/cord-v2) (Park et al., 2019), one per
split: `cord-train-0569`, `cord-validation-0089`, `cord-test-0091`. Images are the original bytes; labels are CORD's
`gt_parse`. Licensed [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Used only by the unit tests.
